title: Finch Circle Complimentary Alteration Credit — Grant, Use, Restoration and Lapse
content:
The complimentary alteration credit of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program is granted, used, restored and lapses as follows.

**(a) Annual grant.** On 1 January each membership in active status receives the annual alteration credit of the tier held that day for the new benefit year (an annual grant); a tier with 0.00 receives no grant.

**(b) Top-up after a tier change.** After an upgrade or card floor during the year, a top-up (a tier top-up grant) equal to the new tier's annual amount less the amounts already granted for that benefit year posts on the change date; nothing is taken back after a downgrade.

**(c) What the credit pays for.** Alteration credit pays only for alterations to items purchased at Marlowe & Finch (the alteration ticket names a purchase record) and is applied to the ticket's alteration charges up to the lower of the charge and the credit balance; it never pays a rush fee, a delivery fee or a non-Marlowe & Finch item.

**(d) Status.** Credit is used only while the membership is in active status, as the membership record shows it.

**(e) Restoration.** When a ticket paid with credit is cancelled before work began or its charge is refunded, the credit used is restored to the benefit year it came from, unless that year has already ended, in which case nothing is restored.

**(f) Lapse.** Unused credit lapses on 31 December (it does not carry over) or on the closed date when the membership closes.

**Status of clause (b).** Clause (b) is no longer in force for a card floor: the top-up posted on the change date of a card floor is the floor top-up of the current card-floor basis. A top-up after an upgrade or any other tier change remains under clause (b), and nothing is taken back after a downgrade.

The annual amount of each tier is that of the alteration credit schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Gold member granted 50.00 on 1 January is upgraded to Finch Circle Diamond in June: the upgrade top-up is 200.00 less 50.00, that is 150.00.
- A ticket with alteration charges of 38.00 and a rush fee of 15.00, for a coat bought at Marlowe & Finch, with a credit balance of 100.00: credit pays 38.00, the lower of the charge and the balance; the rush fee is not paid with credit.
- Credit of 20.00 used in December on a ticket that is cancelled before work began on 4 January of the next year is not restored, because its benefit year has ended.
